Airlines are cutting more flights this year in response to high fuel prices.

Executives from United, American and Southwest Airlines said during an investors conference they expect to eliminate cheaper, less profitable flights from their schedule in the final months of the year.

The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate climbed to 6.95% this week, up from 6.76% last week, according to Freddie Mac. It’s the fourth-straight week of rising rates and the largest one-week jump in mortgage rates in 16 months. https://t.co/VDfe2fQAPF https://t.co/mXJAHWzBST
